name: Tangier
tagline: Gateway port where Africa faces Europe
summary: Tangier is Morocco's storied port on the Strait of Gibraltar, a muse to writers and artists. Climb to the Kasbah, wander the medina from the Grand Socco, sip mint tea at clifftop Café Hafa, and ride out to Cap Spartel and the Caves of Hercules where the Atlantic meets the Mediterranean.
seasonNote: Spring and autumn are mild; summer is busy with Moroccans returning from Europe.
arrival: Fast ferries from Tarifa take an hour; Ibn Battuta Airport is 20 minutes away and the Al Boraq high-speed train reaches Rabat and Casablanca.
gettingAround: Walk the medina; petit taxis for Cap Spartel.
cashTip: Carry small dirham notes for meals, taxis and markets; cards work mainly in hotels and bigger restaurants.
foodTip: Fresh fish, bissara soup and mint tea with a view.
buyTip: Leather, rugs and ceramics in the medina.
baseArea: Medina, Kasbah or the new town
